purpose: prospective new-data replication of the already frozen antecedent score; no retuning during the prospective window

panels.score_ranking_rule: rank separately within each frozen 500-stock panel on the same T; pooled-1000 metrics are auxiliary only

observation_calendar.sampling_rule: calendar is clipped to the frozen prospective start, then the historical weekly_first_trading_days implementation is reused; the first realized T is 2026-09-17
observation_calendar.future_calendar_dates: pending realization; never pre-impute a trading day

score.cross_section: same-T percentile rank within frozen panel

outcome.entry: next normal stock trading day open after T; no jumping if missing/untradeable
outcome.event_seed: exact top 10% of valid H60 MFE observations within each frozen panel and the fixed PV1 observation window only
outcome.event_seed_threshold_timing: compute only after the full PV1 window is mature or deterministically excluded/unknown; no provisional threshold
outcome.event_anchor: earliest T in transitive G7 seed component
outcome.corporate_action_rule: fail-closed exclusion for action within T..H60 using official evidence
outcome.maturity_rule: observation remains pending_maturity until entry plus complete 60 stock trading days and corporate-action evidence are available

registry.pre_outcome_registry: immutable by row hash; feature/rank/score/provenance only; must exist before H60 maturity; corrections are append-only superseding revisions
registry.maturity_outcome_ledger: separate append-only ledger linked by registry row hash

prospective_governance.source_policy: official TWSE/public issuer evidence only for new prospective raw inputs; archive raw payload/page evidence, fetch timestamp and SHA-256 under research-only GCS
prospective_governance.missing_policy: missing or unresolved official evidence remains unknown/pending; never impute canonical facts

acceptance.evaluation_timing: after full frozen PV1 window maturity plus DQ/lineage/no-peeking acceptance
acceptance.S80_S70_lift_capture_and_decile_rates: report fully but do not promote to primary gate after outcomes are visible
acceptance.insufficient_data_semantics: PENDING_MATURITY or INSUFFICIENT_DATA; never package as PASS or forced FAIL
acceptance.failed_directional_confirmation_semantic: NOT_CONFIRMED; retuned results cannot reuse the same blind PV1 label
